html:
New Features

  • Choose from the brand-new Pen Pals cast when picking your avatar for game night.

Improvements

  • Visual styling across all rooms is now unified into a single, polished design.

Bug Fixes

  • Your waiting character is now clearly highlighted if you join a game in progress.
  • Signing in after playing as a guest reliably preserves your rooms and poems.
